review: Fresh no-hook replay passed the 2048 scoped cases for fixed-overflow error OR, NULL-flush tail, empty linear/ring flush, and the mode wrapper cache-hit path. The wrapper outputs FFFFFFFF, zero, and entry R7 from repurposed saved slots.
limitations: Nonempty flush/submission, backing faults, concurrent mutation, physical hardware effects, and untested return/flag state remain unqualified.
